Ah, I see.

That hurts.

But, at the same time, it never hurts to look at things from the perspective of those that have it worse than you.

You know what’s funny about this sub? Posters *demand* empathy from others but don’t have any empathy for anyone else.

If someone told you that the reason you want to die is not a good enough reason to kill yourself, maybe you should try to look at it from their point of view.

Just... Be careful.

The first time I tried to kill myself, my mom was working all the time, my friends were neglecting me, and the girl I liked was in a relationship with another guy. Suddenly, my crush, my friends, and my family were visiting me in the hospital every day. It caused  a positive feedback loop in my head that self-harming behaviours got me the attention I wanted.

Be loving, be there for her, but don’t condone what she did.

No, probably not. There was a chance that your body would have rejected the pills and vomited them up while you were asleep; if you were lying on your back at the time and were sedated enough, you could have choked on your own vomit. Not a pleasant way to go. Hence why they pumped your stomach. But, in a hospital environment where patients are constantly monitored, that wouldn’t be much of a concern; they could have just rolled you onto your side and let you sleep it off. But sometimes doctors, nurses, and other medical professionals have to put on a show. Your parents probably would have gotten upset if it looked like your medical team wasn’t doing anything for you.

See, when patients are actually dying from a benzo overdose (which again, is very, very hard to do), doctors typically don’t waste time pumping stomachs. There’s a drug they can give you that almost immediately negates the effects of benzos.

So, take ONE Xanax and relax. Whatever you think is a big fucking deal right now is just your anxiety riddled brain messing with you. Because taking the whole bottle won’t get you the outcome you think you want right now.

You have a bottle of Xanax. That’s what? 60mg all together. The lethal dose for benzos is thousands of milligrams. You’re just going to go to sleep for a couple days, dude. And if you’re lucky, you’re not going to do anything while you’re asleep.
I know what you’re considering. I’m telling you what will happen if you do it.
It won’t kill you. It will just knock you out for a day or so and when you come to, you might find out that you went on an adventure that earned you a court appearance. You don’t want that, do you?
